scope: File loading, explicit scientific/read options, atomic owned replacement and filesystem writing for the represented mzML subset. No source loaded-file bookkeeping, consumers, full metadata or schema validation claim.
native_boundaries: Owned atomic replacement instead of source reset-before-parse.
Atomic temporary output instead of source direct truncating output.
Shared case-insensitive gzip/bzip2 suffix detection; ZIP input/output unsupported.
All existing XML/binary/selection budgets remain in force.
validation: Native Rust tests and source inspection; no C++ runtime differential execution.
fixture_policy: Reuses the explicitly projected source fixture and source_values oracle documented by tests/data/mzml_load_provenance.json. New compressed fixtures are generated in temporary directories.
